comment: Registry of real CAD models imported into the bench. Sources are the official KiCad libraries (CC BY-SA 4.0 with the KiCad library exception). Run tools/import_cad.py against local KiCad checkouts to regenerate web/public/gltf/models/. Component Search Engine / SamacSys models are NOT listed here: their downloads are account-gated with no public API and terms that do not clearly permit redistribution in a web app -- see docs/3d-asset-pipeline-plan.md.

library.name: KiCad official libraries
library.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 with the KiCad libraries exception

models.part: Radial electrolytic capacitor, 8.0 mm diameter, 3.5 mm pitch
5 mm LED (the bench lamp is a light-emitting load)
